scientific_integrity: Analytical finite-support speed-functional theorem; reproduction-speed comparisons verified by exact convex-duality argument and reproducible numerical checks, not an independently audited result.
scientific_limitations: Applies to identical positive growth multipliers and two specified symmetric lattice kernels; not a general nonlinear front or stochastic invasion theorem; historical-priority risk from broader large-deviation order theory.
title: A unique growth-rate reversal between local and rare long-distance dispersal
